# Solana Trades API

> Query and export historical Solana trades with the Vybe Solana API: SPL and Token-2022 filters for programs, markets, quote mints, wallets and CSV exports.

Live demo of the Vybe Solana API. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## Demo
- [Solana Trades API](https://solana-trades-api.vybenetwork.com/): Query and export historical Solana trades with the Vybe Solana API: SPL and Token-2022 filters for programs, markets, quote mints, wallets and CSV exports.

## Docs
- [Fetch Historical Trades](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/docs/fetch-historical-trades.md)
- [Historical Trades API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_trade_data_program_v4.md)
- [Token Details API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_token_details_v4.md)
- [Top Token Holders API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_top_holders_v4.md)
- [Labeled Programs API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_known_program_accounts_v4.md)
